.. _lvgl_slider:

==============================
2.4 Slider — RGB Color Mixer
==============================

Creating a visual color mixer with three sliders for Red, Green, and Blue channels.

Overview
========

This project demonstrates **Slider** widgets. Three independent sliders (R, G, B ranges 0–255) control the color of a circular preview object in real time — a responsive, visual way to understand RGB color mixing.

What You'll Learn
=================

* Creating and configuring sliders (``lv_slider``)
* Setting slider range, value, and visual style (indicator & knob colors)
* Creating custom-shaped objects (circular "ball")
* Real-time UI update from slider value changes

How the Code Works
==================

**Three Sliders**

Each slider is styled with its channel's color for the indicator and knob:

.. code-block:: cpp

   lv_obj_t *slider = lv_slider_create(lv_scr_act());
   lv_slider_set_range(slider, 0, 255);
   lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(slider, lv_palette_main(LV_PALETTE_RED),
                              LV_PART_INDICATOR);

**Color Preview Object**

A custom circular object reflects the mixed color:

.. code-block:: cpp

   static lv_obj_t *ball;

   static void slider_cb(lv_event_t *e) {
       int r = lv_slider_get_value(slider_r);
       int g = lv_slider_get_value(slider_g);
       int b = lv_slider_get_value(slider_b);

       lv_color_t mixed = lv_color_make(r, g, b);
       lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(ball, mixed, 0);
   }

Expected Result
===============

- Three horizontal sliders (Red, Green, Blue)
- A large circular preview changes color in real time as you drag any slider
- Numeric labels under each slider show the current value

Move all sliders to create any color from the 24-bit RGB palette.
